schema_and_order: Exact CSV field names, row order, candidate/band/model/epoch strings
tiny_values: For nonzero reference magnitude below 1e-8, relative tolerance only; exact zero uses absolute tolerance.
scientific_summary: Exact fields, schema, counts and strings; numeric maxima use the unchanged relative/absolute arcsec criteria. Exact numeric equality reported separately.
internal_assertions: Unchanged: 72 rows, 36 unique pairs, max difference < 1e-4 arcsec.
guards: Existing inspected Python audit hook; no socket except local gethostname, subprocess or outside-QA writes. IERS downloads disabled; library threads 1; below-normal child priority; no GPU.
scope: One provenance-only derivative of historical arithmetic, not new measurements, original historical author code, or a new physical validation.
stop: Any discrepancy stays failed: no numerical retry, source tuning, or tolerance relaxation.
